what: a bandit kingpin: a robber lord, a tall, straight-backed, well-fed human former officer with a trimmed black beard, a waxed moustache and a cold confident stare. He has the realistic anatomy and proportions of an adult man: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.

One arm is much longer than the other, its chest is a rack of too many ribs of different sizes, its head is a single cracked human skull, and tied on its back is a great hump: a tight bundle of spare long bones with three skulls on top.

rawhide straps lashing it together

what: a bone titan: a bare skeleton, and only a skeleton, of a heavy-built ogre. It is all dry bone with empty air between the bones: there is no muscle, no skin and no flesh anywhere on it. Its bones are short and very thick: a wide ribcage of fat curved ribs with dark empty gaps between them and a bare knobbly spine showing below it down to a broad pelvis bone, a wide collarbone, each upper arm one single thick bone, each forearm two thick bones, big knobbly elbow and knee joints, and large hands made of thick separate finger bones. Its skull is small compared with its very wide shoulders: a heavy low-browed skull with a jutting lower jaw and two blunt tusks. Black iron bands with rivets clamp each joint.
colours: weathered grey-white and pale ivory dry bone on every part, dark empty gaps between the bones, black iron bands and rivets, a dull red glow in the eye sockets.
wears: It wears no clothes and no armour; only black iron bands clamped round its shoulders, elbows, hips and knees to hold the bones together.
holds: Both bony hands are empty, the finger bones curled shut. It holds nothing.
pose: It stands on two thick bony legs set wide apart, both arms lifted with the two bony hands clasped together above its skull, about to hammer them down, skull tilted forward.
must_show: a bare skeleton: ribs with gaps, spine, pelvis, bony arms and legs
very thick heavy bones and very wide shoulders
black iron bands at the joints
both empty bone hands raised overhead
no muscle or flesh anywhere
must_not_show: body made of many small skulls

what: a bone colossus: a walking ossuary. It is a broad, heavy upright figure with two arms and two legs, built like a catacomb wall out of dry human bones and human skulls stacked and packed tightly together, with deep dark shadow in every gap so each bone stands out. Its head is three large human skulls side by side, the middle one biggest. Each shoulder is a pile of three large skulls. Its chest is a wall of big skulls in rows above a wide ribcage with dark gaps. Its arms and legs are thick bundles of long bones bound side by side like bundles of sticks, each knee is one large skull, and each hand is a cluster of skulls. A few long thick bone spikes stand up from its shoulders. There is no muscle, no skin and no flesh anywhere on it.
colours: aged yellow-ivory and tan dry bone on every part, very dark brown shadow in the gaps between the bones and in every eye socket, strongly contrasted.
wears: It wears nothing; it is made of bones from head to foot.
holds: Its left hand is empty, a heavy cluster of skulls. Its right hand grips exactly one long, thick, sharp white bone spike, raised overhead to hurl like a javelin.
pose: It strides forward on two thick legs of bundled bones, the right arm drawn back high with the bone spike to throw, the left skull-hand swung forward.
must_show: a figure built entirely from hundreds of small bones and many human skulls
skulls visible at the shoulders, knees and hands
a head made of a cluster of skulls
bone spikes on the shoulders: the most elaborate bone creature
one bone spike in the right hand, left hand empty
